next_step.title: Read a sample of Cerritos's records
next_step.text: Every Cerritos program the harvest could read is loaded for your reading, unchecked. Your verdicts on a sample decide whether the method goes to a second college.

calls.title: Read ten Cerritos records from the tab
calls.text: Six pass the three machine checks: 02201 Architectural Technology A.A., 02213 Secretary/Administrative Assistant A.A., 02226 Engineering Design Technology, 20520 Culinary Arts: Professional Cooking, 24026 GED Test Preparation in Spanish, 31608 Art History A.A.-T. Four fail one: 32563 Music A.A.-T, 44153 Dental Hygiene B.S., 15512 Woodworking A.S., 02235 Photography A.A. Sign in on the Records view and choose Confirm or Needs a fix on each.
calls.if_no_reply: The Cerritos records stay unchecked, and Sierra does not quote them.

calls.title: Read two records from the tab
calls.text: Irvine Valley's Art A.A. and Santa Monica's Barbering A.S. wait on your reading. Sign in on the Records view, open each record, and choose Confirm or Needs a fix.
calls.if_no_reply: Both records stay unchecked, and Sierra does not quote them.

notes.addenda: The reading agent starts after the Oct 11 census apply.
notes.procedures: 34 colleges have one since Oct 8: the 28 whose map host refuses or never reaches the reader each name the routes tried.
notes.sierra: The funding explainer's text is editable on the Implementation Funding tab since Oct 9, and its controls are underlined words, the First Light rule from that day.
notes.maps: All 32 published maps are settled since Oct 8; Palo Verde's map columns were written that evening.
notes.reading: Cerritos, the first full college: 274 of 288 programs read from their own pages and drafted on Oct 9; 238 pass the three machine checks. All 274 are loaded; 270 wait on a reading, beside the four checked in the pilot.

changes.text: Every Cerritos program the harvest read is loaded for your reading: 270 records, unchecked, beside the four checked in the pilot.
Every Cerritos program was matched to its own catalog page and drafted; 235 of 283 pass the three machine checks.
The funding explainer's typed passages can be edited on the tab, and its header was cleaned to your marks.
The Library tab's open-asks record points at Sheet 57, after your paste.
The Dashboard tab passed its first accessibility pass in light and dark: its calculation notes, College Activity colors, focus rings and small buttons.
The Fact Sheet moved to First Light's type with a dark mode, after you said it looks great.
On the Fact Sheet, Ask Sierra and the Send button read clearly when you point at them.
SkyView's chip colors follow the house palette by day and at night, and three of its controls read clearly at night.
The accessibility pass now reaches a screen nobody has checked before it checks one again.
The funding explainer's Columns menu opens on the screen at every width, here and on this tab.
The privacy page uses the house fonts and follows the dark setting.
The Library's record of the decision sheets points at Sheet 56.
The Fact Sheet's links and buttons reach the 24px size, its toolbar uses words, and on a phone the toolbar scrolls away.
